adjudication.rationale: The two new controller specs only assert `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController < Admin::AdminController` and `Admin::EmbeddingController < Admin::AdminController`, which is a static inheritance check and does not exercise any of the newly added controller behavior. The diff adds nontrivial server-side logic in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (create/update/destroy + `save_host` with `category_id` defaulting to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` and error handling via `render_json_error`) and relies on nested params (`params[:embeddable_host][:host]`, `params[:embeddable_host][:category_id]`), but no spec covers these paths or the JS↔server param contract. This is a concrete, diff-grounded test coverage gap rather than a proven functional defect.
